seasons.label: Spring
seasons.blurb: Everything wakes up at once — beds, weeds and grass all in the same week. We knock out the reset before it gets away from you.

services.name: Spring Cleanup
services.desc: Bed edging, debris haul-away, first mow of the year and a fertilizer kickoff.

services.name: Mulch Refresh
services.desc: Fresh mulch delivered and spread in every bed — dyed or natural, your call.

services.name: Irrigation Startup
services.desc: System flush, zone-by-zone check, and head adjustments before the heat hits.

seasons.label: Summer
seasons.blurb: Grass grows fast, weeds grow faster. This is the season where a missed week actually shows.

services.name: Bed Weeding & Edging Refresh
services.desc: A deep pass through every bed — pulled weeds, crisp edges, hauled away.

services.name: Shrub & Hedge Shaping
services.desc: Hand-shaped or sheared to the look you want, clippings bagged and gone.

services.name: Weed & Pest Spot Treatment
services.desc: Targeted treatment for the patches store-bought spray never fixes.

seasons.label: Fall
seasons.blurb: Leaves don't stop until the trees are bare. We keep the yard from disappearing under them.

services.name: Fall Cleanup & Leaf Haul-Away
services.desc: Every leaf, every bed, hauled off-site — not blown into your neighbor's yard.

services.name: Core Aeration & Overseed
services.desc: Opens up compacted soil and gets new grass established before the ground freezes.

services.name: Irrigation Winterization
services.desc: Full system blowout so a hard freeze doesn't split a line you can't see.

seasons.label: Winter
seasons.blurb: Idaho winters don't care about your morning meeting. We do the driveway before you wake up.

services.name: Snow Removal
services.desc: Driveway and walkways cleared before your first alarm, every storm.

services.name: Dormant Pruning
services.desc: The one time of year trees and shrubs can be cut hard without stressing them.

services.name: Bed & Gutter Winter Clear-Out
services.desc: Debris out of beds and gutters before ice turns it into a dam.

features: Skip weeks for vacation, no penalty

owner.name: Mara Quist
owner.bio: Mara Quist grew up two blocks from a nursery and spent every summer of high school working the register, then the greenhouses, then the crews. Now she's running her own — Larkspur & Ledge started as one truck and a trailer, and it still runs on the same rule: show up when you say you will, and leave the yard looking better than the photo you were quoted from. She's still out on jobs most weeks, not just behind a desk.

misc.plansNote: Corner lot, acreage, or something in between? Text us your square footage and we'll quote it exact.
misc.scopeNote: None of that is off the table — just outside our flat-rate plans. Text us a photo and we'll quote it separately.
